# Ecclesiastes Chapter 8 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**8:1** Who [mi] [is] like-the-wise [ke-he-chakham]? And-who knows [u-mi yode'a] the-interpretation [pesher] of-a-thing [davar]? The-wisdom [chokhmat] of-a-man [adam] illuminates [ta'ir] his-face [panav], and-the-boldness [ve-oz] of-his-face [panav] is-changed [yeshunneh].

**8:2** I [ani] [say]: Keep [shemor] the-mouth [pi] of-the-king [melekh], and-on-account-of [ve-al divrat] the-oath [shevu'at] of-God [Elohim].

**8:3** Do-not-be-hasty [al tivvahel] to-go [telekh] from-his-presence [mi-panav]; do-not-stand [al ta'amod] in-a-matter [be-davar] of-evil [ra], for all [kol] that he-desires [yachpotz] he-does [ya'aseh].

**8:4** Since [ba-asher] the-word [devar] of-the-king [melekh] [has] authority [shilton], and-who will-say [u-mi yomar] to-him: "What are-you-doing [mah ta'aseh]?"

**8:5** The-one-who-keeps [shomer] a-commandment [mitzvah] will-not-know [lo yeda] an-evil [ra] thing [davar]; and-a-time [et] and-judgment [u-mishpat] the-heart [lev] of-the-wise [chakham] knows [yeda].

**8:6** For to-every [le-khol] desire [chefetz] there-is [yesh] a-time [et] and-judgment [u-mishpat], for the-evil [ra'at] of-the-human [ha-adam] [is] great [rabbah] upon-him [alav].

**8:7** For-there-is-none [ki einennu] who-knows [yode'a] what will-be [mah she-yihyeh]; for how [ka-asher] it-will-be [yihyeh], who [mi] will-tell-him [yaggid lo]?

**8:8** There-is-no [ein] human [adam] who-has-authority [shallit] over-the-spirit [ba-ruach] to-retain [li-khlo] the-spirit [et ha-ruach], and-there-is-no [ve-ein] authority [shilton] over-the-day [be-yom] of-death [ha-mavet]; and-there-is-no [ve-ein] discharge [mishlachat] in-war [ba-milchamah], and-wickedness [resha] will-not-deliver [lo yemallet] its-master [et be'alav].

**8:9** All this [et kol zeh] I-saw [ra'iti], and-I-applied [ve-naton] my-heart [et libbi] to-every [le-khol] work [ma'aseh] that is-done [she-na'asah] under the-sun [tachat ha-shamesh]: a-time [et] when the-human [ha-adam] rules [shalat] over-the-human [ba-adam] to-his-harm [le-ra lo].

**8:10** And-so [u-ve-khen] I-saw [ra'iti] the-wicked [resha'im] buried [qevurim]; and-they-came [u-va'u] and-from-the-place [u-mi-meqom] of-the-holy [qadosh] they-would-go [yehalekhu], and-they-were-forgotten [ve-yishtakechu] in-the-city [ba-ir] where [asher] they-had-done [asu] so [ken]. Also this [gam zeh] [is] vapor [havel].

**8:11** Because [asher] the-sentence [pitgam] against-the-work [ma'aseh] of-evil [ha-ra'ah] is-not-executed [ein na'asah] quickly [meherah], therefore [al ken] the-heart [lev] of-the-sons [benei] of-the-human [ha-adam] is-filled [male] in-them [bahem] to-do [la'asot] evil [ra].

**8:12** Though [asher] a-sinner [choté] does [oseh] evil [ra] a-hundred [me'at] [times] and-prolongs [u-ma'arikh] [his life] to-him [lo], yet also [gam] I know [yode'a ani] that it-will-be [yihyeh] good [tov] for-those-who-fear [le-yir'ei] God [ha-Elohim], who fear [she-yir'u] before-him [mi-lefanav].

**8:13** But-good [ve-tov] it-will-not-be [lo yihyeh] for-the-wicked [la-rasha], and-he-will-not-prolong [ve-lo ya'arikh] [his] days [yamim] like-a-shadow [ka-tzel], because [asher] he-does-not [einennu] fear [yare] before [mi-lifnei] God [Elohim].

**8:14** There-is [yesh] a-vapor [havel] that is-done [asher na'asah] on the-earth [al ha-aretz]: there-are [yesh] righteous-ones [tzaddiqim] to-whom [asher] it-happens [maggi'a] according-to-the-work [ke-ma'aseh] of-the-wicked [ha-resha'im], and-there-are [ve-yesh] wicked-ones [resha'im] to-whom-it-happens [she-maggi'a] according-to-the-work [ke-ma'aseh] of-the-righteous [ha-tzaddiqim]. I-said [amarti] that-also-this [she-gam zeh] [is] vapor [havel].

**8:15** And-I-praised [ve-shibbachti ani] joy [et ha-simchah], for-there-is-nothing [asher ein] good [tov] for-the-human [la-adam] under the-sun [tachat ha-shamesh] except [ki im] to-eat [le'ekhol] and-to-drink [ve-lishtot] and-to-rejoice [ve-lismo'ach]; and-it [ve-hu] will-accompany-him [yilvennu] in-his-toil [ba-amalo] [through] the-days [yemei] of-his-life [chayyav] that God [ha-Elohim] gave-him [natan lo] under the-sun [tachat ha-shamesh].

**8:16** When [ka-asher] I-applied [natati] my-heart [et libbi] to-know [la-da'at] wisdom [chokhmah] and-to-see [ve-lir'ot] the-business [et ha-inyan] that is-done [asher na'asah] on the-earth [al ha-aretz] — for neither [ki gam] by-day [be-yom] nor-by-night [u-va-lailah] [does] sleep [shenah] [come] to-his-eyes [be-einav] —

**8:17** then-I-saw [ve-ra'iti] all [et kol] the-work [ma'aseh] of-God [ha-Elohim], that the-human [ha-adam] is-not-able [lo yukhal] to-find-out [limtzo] the-work [et ha-ma'aseh] that is-done [asher na'asah] under the-sun [tachat ha-shamesh]; inasmuch-as [be-shel asher] the-human [ha-adam] toils [ya'amol] to-seek [le-vaqqesh] and-will-not-find [ve-lo yimtza]; and-even [ve-gam] if the-wise-man [he-chakham] says [yomar] he-knows [la-da'at], he-is-not-able [lo yukhal] to-find [limtzo].

---

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "interpretation" (pesher):** The word *pesher* is a Persian loanword, one of the indicators of Ecclesiastes' late date. It appears in the Hebrew Bible only here and in the Qumran *pesharim* (interpretive commentaries).

**v.10 — Textual difficulty:** This verse is notoriously corrupt in the Hebrew. The meaning of the wicked being "buried and coming" from the holy place and being "forgotten" is debated. EMET preserves the MT as-is without emendation.

**v.11 — "sentence" (pitgam):** Another Persian loanword (*patigama*), appearing only here and in Esther 1:20. This is strong evidence for a post-exilic date of composition.

**v.15 — The enjoyment refrain:** This is the fifth occurrence of Qoheleth's recurring positive conclusion: eat, drink, and be joyful. In chapter 8, it comes immediately after the observation that the righteous and wicked receive each other's due — making it not escapism but a rational response to moral opacity.

*-- EMET*
